comparison.objective: Candidate calibrates and locks a gripper opening stop; PR-1805 secures a bicycle wheel to a stand with a bent-foot U-lock.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial driver/wrench engagement and rotational counterholding; PR-1805 requires threading a rigid shackle through spokes and around a stand, angled toe insertion, pivoting and two-end crossbar seating.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades retained target angle through repeated motion; PR-1805 grades correct linkage of wheel and stand, bounded two-end latch seating, release clearance and stillness. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Bent-foot two-part lock assembly around fixed objects tests constrained threading and latching, not adjustment preservation against threaded locking torque.
